# What happens to pGOLD once it is built, and how it is confirmed on the way.
#
# THE CONSTRUCTION FILE ENDS AT THE TRANSFORMATION. JCA, 2026-09-18: *"the construction file
# basically ends at transformation. So, if the characterization file was empty, you would end the
# labsheet at construction."* Picking, minipreps and sequencing used to be INJECTED for any
# experiment that did not write them, which manufactured a pick nobody authored — and a pick
# nobody authored cannot say which colonies to take. So the verification chain is declared here
# now, like everything else in this half, and it is what the live Lactis3 files already did.

# --- confirming it ---
Pick	pGOLD	n=4 phenotype=white, kanamycin-resistant clone=Mach1/pGOLD	pGOLD_colonies
Miniprep	pGOLD_colonies	clone=pGOLD	pGOLD_dna
Sequence	pGOLD_dna	oligos=goSEQF,goSEQR reads=F,R	pGOLD_reads
Analysis	pGOLD_reads	verifies=pGOLD	pGOLD_verified

# --- what it is for ---
Retransform	pGOLD	host=L.lactis antibiotic=Kan temp=30 method=electroporation negative=untransformed positive=pCTRL	pGOLD_host
Pick	pGOLD_host	n=4 phenotype=growing on the selective plate, fluorescent under blue light clone=L.lactis/pGOLD lighting=blue+ambient	pGOLD_clones
Culture	pGOLD_clones	medium=LB+Kan vessel=24-well volume=4mL temp=30 to=saturation inoculate=untransformed:LB	pGOLD_cultures
Assay	pGOLD_cultures	protocol=plate_reader_fluorescence reporter=GFP ex=485 em=515 od=600 replicates=2	gold_assay
